title: Fix aggregation view
description:
Improving the aggregation feature.

AI-Assisted: no

notes.body: mentioned in merge request !20993

This tries to improve https://gitlab.com/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/20993.

@stigbjorlykke  any feedback?
It's on my todo list. I will come to this when I have some time.
Thank you!
@LarsVoelker Have you had any time to look at my comments? I would like to have this fixed before the 4.7.0 development release which happens April 16.
This should be fixed.

I think the detailed description should be moved to the tooltip.
```suggestion:-0+0
	<string>Aggregation fields</string>
```

suggestions.from_content: <string>Aggregation fields (Only packets containing the aggregation fields are displayed)</string>

left review comments
@LarsVoelker Any progress looking at my comments?
Yes. Expect an update shortly.
It would be nice to have this fixed before the 4.7.0rc release end of May.

@stigbjorlykke  Thanks for being patient with us!

I pushed updates and I think Hamdi solved your comments. I am just not sure with one (see above).

Overall, it looks so much better now and I think this is a major step forward.

P.S. We were also discussing on adding like a counter for each line in aggregation mode but I think this is something for a later MR.
I agree, and let's do the counter in a separate MR.

```
asciidoctor: WARNING: GIF image format not supported. Install the prawn-gmagick gem or convert images/ws-aggregation-view-example.gif to PNG.

@geraldcombs, perhaps we should have that as a commit check or similar?

Oh, I did not pay attention to this giant animated gif with 188 frames. The documentation is for the preferences but the gif animates an example of use. I suggest we change this to a screenshot of the preferences like the other chapters.

I did not see that too.
